featured_reviews.name: Note from Travelam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Mumbai Dabbawala collection point near the railway station was one of the most fascinating experiences of my Mumbai trip. Watching thousands of lunch boxes being sorted, grouped, and dispatched with remarkable precision was truly impressive.

Our guide explained the entire system in detail, from the collection of home-cooked meals to the complex sorting process and their timely delivery across the city. What amazed me most was how this world-famous network operates with such efficiency, accuracy, and coordination, largely without the use of advanced technology.

The dedication, discipline, and teamwork of the Dabbawalas are inspiring. Seeing this unique logistics system in action gave me a whole new appreciation for the people who keep Mumbai moving every day. A highly recommended experience for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to understand the city’s incredible work culture and spirit.

featured_reviews.name: macedonboy
featured_reviews.review_text:
This statue stands in tribute to the Dabbawala, the lunchbox delivery men of India who deliver lunch from restaurants to people's homes and workplaces.

The sculpture is made up of disks to form a structure of a stereotypical Dabbawala carrying a tiffin box in both arms. The sculpture is a fun and wonderful monument to the ordinary man. The statue is close the the famous Haji Ali Mosque and is worth a detour if you can spare 10 minutes.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Mumbai's Dabbawalas are world famous for their timely delivery and immaculate service. Their business model even piqued the interest of Harvard Business School compelling professors to study their distinctive business model.
The 13-foot long statue, designed of stainless steel discs by Mumbai-based sculptor Valay Shende, was unveiled at Haji Ali on Friday. The installation is part of a private art foundation in partnership with Mumbai's municipal corporation.

featured_reviews.name: MILAN ZATAKIA
featured_reviews.review_text: A piece of Mumbai history. The famous dabbawallahs are none other than the lunch tiffin carriers who have an amazing network of delivery men who use the local railway network to deliver hot meals from Customer residences to their offices in every nook and corner of Mumbai. Global universities like Harvard and IIMA have conducted studies on the efficiency of this business model. Prince Charles of England too was very impressed with this operation. It is only befitting for this concept to be honoured with a statue at a strategic junction like haji Ali,  the Gateway to South Mumbai. Truly remarkable.

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Kumar Panjiyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai's Dabbawalas are world famous for their timely delivery and immaculate service. Their business model even piqued the interest of Harvard Business School compelling professors to study their distinctive business model.

Heck, they have also been honoured by the British royal family!

And now, after decades of ferrying delicious and hygienically cooked food to thousands of Mumbaikars from homes to offices, the Dabbawalas get their very own art installation, in the form of a statue of a Dabbawala, standing tall and proud, readying himself to deliver the tiffin.

The 13-foot long statue, designed of stainless steel discs by Mumbai-based sculptor Valay Shende, was unveiled at Haji Ali on Friday. The installation is part of a private art foundation in partnership with Mumbai's municipal corporation.

2) The other item sent as a vegetable was CHOLE! Is CHOLE A VEGETABLE?
3) After informing them that the second vegetable had not been sent, I was told it would be delivered in 10 minutes(I live close to the tiffin service place). It was delivered after almost an hour. Seems like the vegetable prepared for the day must have been over because what I received was PANEER BHURJI. AGAIN NOT A VEGETABLE!
4) The item sent as a dal was a WATERY KADHI with nothing in it. Is KADHI A DAL?

featured_reviews.name: Renu Dodeja
featured_reviews.review_text: I received tiffin two days properly and on third day I received only sabzi and chapati was missing. I complained but no response received. I then stopped placing order but then too no action was taken. Pathetic service.

featured_reviews.name: anjali joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I highly recommend Health Bag Meal tiffin service! I ordered their tiffins for a month during a time when my husband and I were down with chicken gunya, and our cook was on long leave. Health Bag Meal truly was a lifesaver.

The food is hygienic, non-spicy, and absolutely delicious. Everything is delivered right to your doorstep in sealed bags, so there’s no spilling, mixing, or misplacement. The containers are microwave-safe, making it very convenient to reheat.

What impressed me most is the variety in the menu — no dish was repeated over the entire month! They also don’t use baking powder or baking soda, and we had zero digestion issues. The variety of vegetables and dals was particularly commendable.

Mr. Harish Sharma, the owner, is very courteous, always responds promptly and addresses the queries satisfactorily. On request, he provided vegetables without onion and garlic for my parents, and they loved them. On one occasion, there was a small mix-up in the order, but he promptly sent the correct vegetables again at no extra charge — a truly heartwarming gesture.

Overall, Health Bag Meal combines user-friendly, hygiene, and delicious home-style food with excellent customer service. I’ve already recommended them to many and I will continue to do so!

featured_reviews.name: Vidit Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been taking healthbag meal Tiffin services for more than 17 months and still their services as well as food quality remained top notch. Especially the owner Mr. Harish Sharma is such a generous person as he listens the customer request, complaints and he make sure that it will not be done in the near future. I would really recommend to opt for this tiffin services as in South Bombay you can’t get such a delicious homely cooked food at a quite decent price.

The first time I had the Malvani-style chicken curry, and today I ordered the Malai Chicken Curry. Both meals were absolutely delicious. The food tasted fresh, flavourful, and genuinely home-cooked. The chicken was well cooked, and the gravies were rich and packed with flavour.

The portion size was generous, with enough curry and chapatis to make for a very satisfying meal. It's not easy to find a tiffin service that consistently delivers both quality and taste, but Homely Breakfast n Tiffins has impressed me on both occasions.

A special thanks to Ms. Swati Hate and the team for maintaining such good quality. Looking forward to ordering again and trying more dishes from the menu.

featured_reviews.name: Shivali Balgi
featured_reviews.review_text: We had lots of guests for a function and had ordered breakfast & lunch for 2 days. They had great variety of food choices and we're ready to make changes in the menu as per our requirements as we wanted food without onion and garlic. Food was tasty😋 , fresh and value for money. Most important food was delivered on time and in sufficient quantity. Standout items were the Sabudana khichdi, Chole, beetroot koshimbir and beetroot chapati. Thanks a lot to Amar & Swati for your services and keep up the good work👏👏

featured_reviews.name: Dr Mohinish Bhatjiwale
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have been taking lunch from them regularly. Started for my son at work. He enjoyed the lunch so much and insisted we take the lunch service for ourselves too! The food is healthy, very tasty with a lot of variety. It is also delivered fresh and hot.
We would strongly recommend this service for anyone who needs a tiffin.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Appreciate the time given to write for us.

featured_reviews.name: Monaz Vimadalal
featured_reviews.review_text: This tiffin service providers are extremely unprofessional rude & fake to begin with. Even with customers who have been taking tiffin regularly they have no sense to talk to their customers. To start with they increased the prices every end of year which is accepted then in the middle they increased twice & when said to consider their reply is extremely rude. I wish I could have posted the chats here for proof. Also no information after keeping customers waiting for tiffin over that when requested to maintain what they commit their response is rude again. In the beginning they pretend to be nice on that basis I had posted a review that too bcz I was asked by them but if you have to deal with them for long they will show their true colors. Will never recommend anyone to take tiffins from such place regularly. Highly unprofessional.

featured_reviews.name: B. SHASHI KIRAN
featured_reviews.review_text: Food is really tasty. I regularly order dinner (veg and non-veg) for my daughters, and it’s simply yummy notably chicken and fish curries. Swati Ji is very humble and great to deal with. I would strongly recommend homely food: authentic and healthy!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your valuable feedback.

featured_reviews.name: Mehika Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered from homely tiffin services recently .. and it was a lovely experience. She was kind and accommodating to all our requests. Food was tasty and hygienic, with lots of variety ! Highly recommend

featured_reviews.name: Jesee Bhatacharjii
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a fair few guests living at our home for my wedding. Relatives had come in and I didn't want to stress over breakfast. I searched Google for breakfast delivery services and came across this one. The reviews do not do justice to their services. The food is priced well and tastes delicious! Great variety too! The owners make the food themselves. They are warm, considerate and quick to respond. I don't usually leave a lot of Google reviews, but these guys deserve it. Thank you for destressing my wedding, Swatiji. Many regards. Will definitely come back when needed.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Appreciate your valuable feedback given in between your wedding. Will alway remember you.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: Great Taste, Great food and overall excellent service. Being a outstation student, all the food feels homely with the perfect amount of spice and proper usage of oil. Would recommend this place to everyone living away from their homes

name: Dabbawala's Kitchen
description: At Mumbai Dabbawalas Kitchen, we take immense pride in our rich culinary heritage and social impact. We are more than just a kitchen – we are the fourth-generation successors of the legendary Mumbai Dabbawalas. With a commitment to excellence and tradition, we deliver authentic flavors while empowering local women through a Women's Self-Help Group. Join us on a gastronomic journey that combines taste, quality, and social responsibility. Experience the legacy of Mumbai Dabbawalas and support our mission of making a difference one meal at a time.
